name: Mixwave - Stitcher
description: Mixwave is a self-hostable platform that aims to simplify the complexities of video delivery. Transcode and package your media for online streaming with simple API calls and sane defaults, or craft dynamic HLS playlists on the fly with bumpers, ads and filters.
requires:
This is the Stitcher agent for the Mixin suite. It requires other Mixin containers to be running. 
        [br]
        This container requires a separate Redis database.

ports.name: Application Port
ports.description: Port over which other containers will communicate with this container

variables.name: Public API Endpoint
variables.description: Publicly accessible URL for Mixin API container. Replace with your IP or domain.

variables.name: Public Stitcher Endpoint
variables.description: Publicly accessible URL for Mixin Stitcher container. Replace with your IP or domain.

variables.name: Public AWS S3 Endpoint
variables.description: Publicly accessible URL for S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 Endpoint
variables.description: URL for S3 storage bucket (minus bucket name) used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 Bucket
variables.description: Name of the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 Region
variables.description: Region of the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 Access Key
variables.description: Access key for the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.

variables.name: AWS S3 Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key for the S3 storage bucket used to store media files.
